section.p: The light of a star begins a long journey before it reaches your eyes. Even the nearest stars are so distant that their light travels for years. Looking up is a small way of looking back in time.

Stars form inside enormous clouds of gas and dust. Gravity draws material together. As the center grows hotter and denser, the ingredients for a new source of light gather in the dark.

People have always drawn stories between the stars. The constellations are maps of imagination as much as maps of the sky. Tonight, find one bright point of light and let your own story begin.
